Its learning was to cap pushes at two per order because fatigue and opt-outs appeared after the third push. The proposal neither cites the experiment nor includes a push cap.","evidence_quote":"Send live tracking push notifications when the driver is five minutes away.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-035-live-tracking-nudges"],"recommendation":"Reference EXP-035, explain what this proposal changes relative to it, and adopt the cap of two pushes per order.
